# podman-mcp — Full LLM Reference

**Version**: 3.5.0 | **Ports**: 11112 (frontend) / 11113 (backend + MCP /mcp)
**Stack**: FastMCP 3.5 · Python 3.12+ · React 19 · Vite · Tailwind · Zustand

## Architecture

```
LLM Agent (Claude/Cursor/opencode)
    ├── stdio JSON-RPC → FastMCP (podman-mcp) → podman CLI (native/WSL2) → Podman Machine
    └── HTTP REST → FastAPI Bridge (:11113) → same pipeline

React Webapp (:11112) → FastAPI (:11113) → podman CLI → Podman Machine
```

Dual transport: stdio for Claude Desktop, HTTP for webapp/opencode. The same
FastMCP singleton serves both — no separate server process. `run_server.py` entry
point detects `MCP_PORT` env var: if set → HTTP mode; if absent → stdio mode.

## MCP Tools — Complete Reference

All tools follow the portmanteau pattern (discriminator-based operations).
Each tool is decorated with `@mcp.tool()` and `@check_podman_available`.

### manage_containers
`tools/containers.py` — Container lifecycle, introspection, and resource management.

Operations: `list`, `inspect`, `start`, `stop`, `restart`, `delete`, `create`, `logs`, `stats`, `exec`, `files`, `resources`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `list` | — | All containers (running + stopped) |
| `inspect` | `container_id` | Low-level JSON config |
| `start` / `stop` / `restart` | `container_id` | Lifecycle control |
| `delete` | `container_id` | Force-remove (`podman rm -f`) |
| `create` | `image` (+ `container_name`, `ports`, `volumes`, `env`, `cmd_args`) | Run new container in background |
| `logs` | `container_id` (+ `tail_lines=100`) | Recent stdout/stderr |
| `stats` | `container_id` | Instant CPU/memory/IO metrics |
| `exec` | `container_id`, `exec_cmd` | Run command inside container |
| `files` | `container_id`, `file_op` (`list`/`read`/`write`), `container_path` (+ `file_content`) | In-container file I/O |
| `resources` | `container_id`, `resource_op` (`get`/`set`), `cpu_limit`, `memory_limit` | Get/set CPU & memory limits |

### manage_pods
`tools/pods.py` — Kubernetes-style pod management (Podman-unique, no Docker equivalent).

Operations: `list`, `inspect`, `create`, `start`, `stop`, `delete`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `list` | — | All pods |
| `inspect` | `pod_id` | Low-level pod config |
| `create` | `pod_name`, `ports`, `volumes` | Create pod namespace |
| `start` / `stop` | `pod_id` | Pod lifecycle |
| `delete` | `pod_id` | Force-remove pod |

### manage_images
`tools/images.py` — Image registry operations.

Operations: `list`, `inspect`, `pull`, `delete`, `build`, `search`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `list` | — | Local images |
| `inspect` | `image_name` | Image metadata |
| `pull` | `image_name` (+ `timeout`) | Pull from registry |
| `delete` | `image_name` | Force-remove image |
| `build` | `build_context`, `dockerfile`, `tag` | Build from Dockerfile/Containerfile |
| `search` | `search_term` | Search registry |

### manage_system
`tools/system.py` — Machine lifecycle, volumes, networks, systemd generation, prune.

Operations: `status`, `info`, `machine_list`, `machine_init`, `machine_start`, `machine_stop`, `prune`, `generate_systemd`, `volume_list`, `volume_create`, `volume_delete`, `network_list`, `network_create`, `network_delete`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `status` | — | CLI health, machine list, rootless flag, container/image counts |
| `info` | — | Full `podman info --format json` |
| `machine_list` | — | VM environments |
| `machine_init` | — | Scaffold new VM |
| `machine_start` | — | Boot VM |
| `machine_stop` | — | Halt VM |
| `prune` | — | `podman system prune -f` |
| `generate_systemd` | `container_id` or `name` | Generate systemd unit from container |
| `volume_list` / `_create` / `_delete` | `name` (for create/delete) | Volume CRUD |
| `network_list` / `_create` / `_delete` | `name` (for create/delete) | Network CRUD |

### manage_compose
`tools/compose.py` — Multi-container stack orchestration via `podman compose`.

Operations: `up`, `down`, `ps`, `logs`, `build`, `config`, `debug`

All operations require `project_path` (directory containing the compose file).
Uses `--workdir` global option for directory independence.

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `up` | `project_path` | Build and start stack in background |
| `down` | `project_path` (+ `volumes`) | Stop and remove stack |
| `ps` | `project_path` | List compose services |
| `logs` | `project_path` | Aggregated logs (last 100 lines) |
| `build` | `project_path` | Pre-build images |
| `config` | `project_path` | Resolve final compose config |
| `debug` | `project_path` | Diagnose compose setup (paths, version, file existence) |

### manage_backup
`tools/backup.py` — Image/container/volume/compose save and restore. **DESTRUCTIVE annotation**.

Operations: `save_image`, `load_image`, `export_container`, `import_container`, `save_volume`, `load_volume`, `save_compose`, `list_backups`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `save_image` | `name`, `output_path` | `podman save -o <path> <image>` |
| `load_image` | `output_path` (+ `tag`) | `podman load -i <path>` |
| `export_container` | `name`, `output_path` | Export container filesystem to tar |
| `import_container` | `output_path`, `name` (+ `tag`) | Import tar as image |
| `save_volume` | `name`, `output_path` | Backup volume to tar.gz via alpine helper |
| `load_volume` | `name`, `output_path` | Restore volume from tar.gz |
| `save_compose` | `name` (project path), `output_path` | Snapshot compose project metadata |
| `list_backups` | `output_path` | List backup archives in directory |

### manage_migrate
`tools/migrate.py` — Docker↔Podman porting. **No Docker installation required** — uses podman CLI for everything.

Operations: `docker_compose_to_podman`, `podman_compose_to_docker`, `scan_docker_artifacts`, `migrate_image`, `compatibility_check`, `dockerfile_to_containerfile`, `export_for_docker`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `docker_compose_to_podman` | `source_path` (+ `output_path`) | Convert docker-compose.yml for Podman |
| `podman_compose_to_docker` | `source_path` (+ `output_path`) | Reverse conversion |
| `scan_docker_artifacts` | `source_path` (optional) | Find compose files, Dockerfiles, images |
| `migrate_image` | `image_name` (+ `new_name`) | Pull Docker Hub image, re-tag for Podman |
| `compatibility_check` | `source_path` | Check compose for unsupported features (deploy, secrets, configs, service_healthy) |
| `dockerfile_to_containerfile` | `source_path` | Copy Dockerfile → Containerfile |
| `export_for_docker` | `image_name` (+ `output_path`) | Export as docker-archive for `docker load -i` |

### manage_agentic
`tools/agentic.py` — Multi-step autonomous workflows. **DESTRUCTIVE annotation**. Always runs with `dry_run=True` by default.

Operations: `deploy_compose`, `cleanup`, `diagnose`, `rollback`, `health_sweep`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `deploy_compose` | `project_path` (+ `dry_run`) | Validate → pull → up, step-by-step reporting |
| `cleanup` | `dry_run` | Prune stopped containers, dangling images, volumes, networks |
| `diagnose` | `project_path` (optional) | Scan exited/restarting/unhealthy containers |
| `rollback` | `project_path` (+ `dry_run`) | Down → up cycle |
| `health_sweep` | `dry_run` | Check health of all running containers, restart unhealthy |

### manage_health
`tools/health.py` — READ_ONLY annotation. Container health analysis and system overview.

Operations: `container_analyze`, `system_overview`, `recommendations`

| Op | Parameters | Description |
|----|-----------|-------------|
| `container_analyze` | `container_id` | Restart count, OOM killed, exit code, log error scan, memory pressure |
| `system_overview` | — | Aggregate counts, restart loops, disk usage |
| `recommendations` | — | Prioritized fix suggestions (high/medium/low) |

## REST API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | `/api/health` | Health check |
| GET | `/api/dashboard` | Aggregate: containers + images + system + pods |
| GET | `/api/containers` | Container list |
| GET | `/api/pods` | Pod list |
| GET | `/api/images` | Image list |
| GET | `/api/volumes` | Volume list |
| POST | `/api/volumes/create` | Create volume |
| POST | `/api/volumes/delete` | Delete volume |
| GET | `/api/networks` | Network list |
| POST | `/api/networks/create` | Create network |
| POST | `/api/networks/delete` | Delete network |
| GET | `/api/system` | System status + info + disk |
| GET | `/api/compose/projects` | Scan for compose files |
| GET | `/api/compose/ps` | Compose process status |
| POST | `/api/compose/up` | Compose up |
| POST | `/api/compose/down` | Compose down |
| GET | `/api/compose/logs` | Compose logs |
| POST | `/api/chat` | Chat (Ollama/LM Studio/agentic) |
| GET | `/api/logs` | Activity log query |
| GET | `/api/logs/stats` | Log stats |
| GET | `/api/logs/export` | Log export (JSON/CSV) |
| DELETE | `/api/logs` | Clear logs |
| GET | `/api/v1/diagnostics` | CUA smoke test diagnostics |
| POST | `/api/podman/recover` | Restart Podman machine |
| GET | `/api/capabilities` | Page flags, tool_count, LLM providers |
| GET | `/api/tools` | Tool names |
| GET | `/api/llm/providers` | LLM provider discovery (Ollama/LM Studio) |

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `PODMAN_CMD` | auto-detect | Podman CLI path override |
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | `stdio` | Transport: stdio / http / sse |
| `MCP_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | HTTP bind address |
| `MCP_PORT` | `11113` | HTTP port |
| `MCP_PATH` | `/mcp` | HTTP endpoint path |
| `MCP_USER` / `MCP_PASS` | — | Basic auth for /api/chat |
| `PODMAN_MCP_SAMPLING_BASE_URL` | — | LLM endpoint for ctx.sample() |
| `PODMAN_MCP_SAMPLING_MODEL` | — | Model for ctx.sample() |
| `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:11434` | Ollama endpoint |
| `LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:1234` | LM Studio endpoint |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `WARNING` | Log level |
| `PODMAN_MCP_LOG_MAX_ENTRIES` | `1000` | Ring buffer size |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_URLS` | — | Comma-separated MCP proxy URLs |

## Project Structure

```
podman-mcp/
├── src/
│   ├── server.py                  # FastAPI app + CORS + lifespan
│   ├── customization/             # uvicorn entry wrapper
│   ├── podmanmcp/
│   │   ├── mcp_instance.py        # FastMCP singleton
│   │   ├── tool_registration.py   # Tool module imports
│   │   ├── podman_context.py      # CLI resolution + subprocess
│   │   ├── fleet_surface.py       # Prefab cards + prompts
│   │   └── tools/                 # 9 portmanteau tools
│   │       ├── containers.py
│   │       ├── pods.py
│   │       ├── images.py
│   │       ├── system.py
│   │       ├── compose.py
│   │       ├── backup.py
│   │       ├── migrate.py
│   │       ├── agentic.py
│   │       └── health.py
│   └── podman_mcp/
│       ├── web.py                 # REST endpoints
│       ├── config.py              # Sampling config
│       ├── auth.py                # Basic auth
│       ├── activity_log.py        # Ring buffer logger
│       └── llm/                   # LLM provider manager
├── web_sota/                      # React/Vite frontend
│   └── src/
│       ├── App.tsx                # Router (13 routes)
│       ├── pages/                 # 13 page components
│       ├── components/layout/     # Sidebar, Topbar, AppLayout
│       ├── lib/api.ts             # API_BASE
│       └── store/connection.ts    # Zustand connection state
├── justfile
├── pyproject.toml
└── uv.lock
```
